scorecard.rationale: A sweet basil extract trial reports menopausal composites that include fatigue, with no separate estimate. The holy basil study's fatigue comparison was inconclusive and tested a different species. A dried-sweet-basil effect on Parkinson fatigue remains unresolved. Related cultural/experiential records (1) provide uncontrolled context without changing the open efficacy rating. A signaling review links sweet basil to isolated rosmarinic acid assays. It adds no culinary exposure or fatigue result.
